name: Zhihu
text:
#!name=知乎
#!desc=某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思
#!homepage=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts
#!icon=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/icons/gif/naisi-01.gif
#!raw-url=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/raw/main/Loon/plugin/split/partZ/Zhihu.lpx
#!tg-channel=https://t.me/inaisi
#!date=2026-11-11 21:17:23
#############################################


[Argument]
vihu_enable = switch,true,false,tag=知乎-脚本开关

[Rule]
USER-AGENT,AVOS*, REJECT
DOMAIN, appcloud.zhihu.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, appcloud2.in.zhihu.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, mqtt.zhihu.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, sugar.zhihu.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, crash2.zhihu.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, 118.89.204.198, REJECT
DOMAIN, zxid-m.mobileservice.cn, REJECT
IP-CIDR, 118.89.204.198/32, REJECT, no-resolve
IP-CIDR, 103.41.167.237/32, REJECT, no-resolve
IP-CIDR6, 2402:4e00:1200:ed00:0:9089:6dac:96b6/128, REJECT, no-resolve



[Rewrite]
# 首页 - 悬浮图标、顶部横幅、开屏广告、关注页推荐、推荐信息流、热榜信息流、热榜直播、回答底部卡片
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/commercial_api\/(?:answer\/\d+\/bottom-v2|article\/\d+\/bottom-v2|banners_v3\/app_topstory_banner|launch_v2|real_time_launch_v2)/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/content-distribution-core\/bubble\/common\/settings/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/(?:moments\/lastread|drama\/hot-drama-list)/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/root\/window/i then reject_dict(200)
# 会员页面 - 弹窗、悬浮动图
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/(?:bazaar\/float_window|market\/popovers_v2)/i then reject_dict(200)
# 我的页面 - 项目列表、会员卡片
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/me\/guides/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/unlimited\/go\/my_card/i then reject(404)
# 搜索页 - 关键词、猜你想搜
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/search\/(hot_search|preset_words)/i then reject_dict(200)
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/search\/recommend_query\/v2\?/i then response.body.replace(/"recommend_queries":\{.+\}/, "\"recommend_queries\":{}")
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/www\.zhihu\.com\/api\/v4\/search\/related_queries\/(?:article|answer)\/\d+/i then reject_dict(200)
# 回答详情页 - 评论区顶部、下一个回答
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/comment_v5\/(?:articles|answers)\/\d+\/list-headers/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/prague\/related_suggestion_native\/feed\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/v5\.1\/topics\/answer\/\d+\/relation/i then reject_dict(200)
# 其他 - 服务器推送配置
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/ab\/api\/v1\/products\/zhihu\/platforms\/ios\/config/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/ad-style-service\/request/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/appcloud2\.zhihu\.com\/v3\/resource\?group_name=mp/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/link\.zhihu\.com\/\?target=(?:https?)?(?:%3A|:)?(?:\/\/|%2F%2F)?(.*)/i as urlMatch then redirect(302, "http://${urlMatch.1}")
# 网页版去广告 //www.zhihu.com, zhuanlan.zhihu.com
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/distribute\/rhea\/qa_ad_card\/h5\/recommendation\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/www\.zhihu\.com\/api\/v4\/hot_recommendation/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/www\.zhihu\.com\/api\/v4\/mcn\/v2\/linkcards\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/www\.zhihu\.com\/api\/v4\/(?:answers|questions)\/\d+\/related-readings/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/www\.zhihu\.com\/commercial_api\/banners_v3\/mobile_banner/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/zhuanlan\.zhihu\.com\/api\/articles\/\d+\/recommendation/i then reject(404)

request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/zhstatic\.zhihu\.com\/brand-ad/i then reject(404)


[Script]
# 首页 - 悬浮图标、顶部横幅、开屏广告、关注页推荐、推荐信息流、热榜信息流、热榜直播、回答底部卡片、精简顶部标签
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/(?:api|page-info)\.zhihu\.com\/(?:answers|articles)\/v2\/\d+/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎移除首页推广", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/commercial_api\/app_float_layer/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎移除首页推广", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/feed\/render\/tab\/config\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎移除首页推广", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/(?:moments_v3|topstory\/hot-lists\/total|topstory\/recommend)/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎移除首页推广", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/root\/tab/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎精简顶部标签", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/v2\/topstory\/hot-lists\/everyone-seeing\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎移除首页推广", requires_body=true
# 会员页面 - 弹窗、悬浮动图
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/bazaar\/vip_tab\/header\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎移除会员页面推广", requires_body=true
# 回答详情页 - 评论区顶部、下一个回答
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/next-(?:bff|data|render)/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎移除回答详情页推广", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.zhihu\.com\/questions\/\d+(?:\/answers|\/feeds|\?include=)/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎移除回答详情页推广", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/www\.zhihu\.com\/api\/v4\/(?:articles|answers)\/\d+\/recommendations?\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎移除回答详情页推广", requires_body=true
# 其他 - 服务器推送配置
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/appcloud2\.zhihu\.com\/v3\/config/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎拦截服务器推送配置", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/m-cloud\.zhihu\.com\/api\/cloud\/config\/all\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhihu/zhihu.js") with enable=${vihu_enable}, tag="知乎拦截服务器推送配置", requires_body=true


[MITM]
hostname = api.zhihu.com, www.zhihu.com, appcloud2.zhihu.com, m-cloud.zhihu.com, zhuanlan.zhihu.com, link.zhihu.com
